اغتديا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَدَيَا (iḡtadayā) /iɣ.ta.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# اُغْتُدِيَا (uḡtudiyā) /uɣ.tu.di.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# اِغْتَدِيَا (iḡtadiyā) /iɣ.ta.di.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
